fixOwed: MapThumbnail's Loading story pairs a block Skeleton with a `Skeleton variant="text" className="w-24"` meant to depict the map name loading beside it, but Skeleton's `text` branch (packages/design-system/src/primitives/Skeleton/index.tsx) never applies the caller's `className` to size the line — confirmed independently reproducing on CivilisationIcon's own Loading story, which uses the same pairing — so the second skeleton renders at an indeterminate width and is invisible in the captured frame, making MapThumbnail's Loading baseline pixel-identical to PlayerAvatar's, which never had a second skeleton by design. Fix `Skeleton`'s `text` variant to size itself from the caller's `className` (or add an explicit width prop) so MapThumbnail's Loading baseline actually shows both parts of its own anatomy.
